mentions.h: BRITISH ATHLETICS LEAGUE DIVISION 1: Just four match points adrift of league victory. NEW RIVER STADIUM, HARINGEY, 7 SEP 1991

mentions.note: decathlete, pb 6,092pts 1992; AAA indoor 60m hurdles champion 1990 as a Junior; formerly Gateshead Harriers; student at W.L.I.H.E.

photos.c: Left: Richard Hunter made his debut for Belgrave on September 7th 1991 at New River Stadium, Haringey, placing 2nd in the 'B' 110m hurdles in a legal pb of 15.04. He also clocked 49.96 in the 'B' 400m. Sharing a joke behind him are Belgrave's Ian Wells and Haringey's Dalton Grant.
